purpose: Evidenced table of real cases in BOTH directions: genes where compensation was observed, and genes where a knockout was NOT rescued. A rule validated only on positives is useless, so the negative half is the load-bearing half.

how_to_read.adaptation: Was an adapting gene / paralogue measurably upregulated? true | false | 'not-tested'
how_to_read.phenotype_rescued: Was the organism's phenotype actually normal? true | false | 'partial' | 'unknown'. These two axes are INDEPENDENT -- see vegfaa.
how_to_read.allele_specific: Where the source distinguished alleles, the row is per ALLELE, not per gene. El-Brolosy's own data show two alleles of the same gene behaving oppositely, so a per-gene row would be a lie.
how_to_read.zfin_corroboration: Counts of ZFIN allele-reagent phenotype rows from omics/genomic, split into 'substantive' morphological terms and 'bookkeeping' terms (whole organism increased/decreased amount/absent/dead), which record Mendelian ratios and lethality rather than a defect.

zfin_caveat: ZFIN aggregates ALL alleles of a gene and all publications. A gene whose canonical decay-competent allele is phenotypically silent can still carry many substantive ZFIN rows contributed by an RNA-less allele or a later paper. Per-gene ZFIN counts therefore CANNOT confirm an allele-level compensation claim, and are reported here only as corroboration or as an explicit conflict.

evidence.quote: hbegfa, vcla, hif1ab, vegfaa, egfl7 and alcama zebrafish mutants exhibit increased mRNA levels of a paralogue or family member (hereafter referred to as 'adapting gene'), namely hbegfb, vclb, epas1a and epas1b, vegfab, emilin3a and alcamb, respectively (Fig. 1a).
hbegfaΔ7, hbegfasa18135, hbegfafull locus del., vclaΔ13, vclasa14599, vclaexon22_ins1, alcamaΔ10, and alcamapromoter-less mutants do not exhibit any obvious defects under a dissecting microscope.

zfin_corroboration.note: The one substantive term is 'blood circulation decreased rate', which matches the phenotype El-Brolosy report for the RNA-LESS allele, not this one. Consistent.

evidence.quote: while analyzing various mutant alleles, we found that unlike hbegfaΔ7 and vclaΔ13, two other PTC bearing alleles, hbegfasa18135 and vclasa14599, do not display transcriptional adaptation

cases.why_it_matters: Same gene, same lesion CLASS (PTC), opposite outcome. Our classifier sees only the lesion class, so it will predict adaptation here and be WRONG. This case is the reason 'plausible-by-rule' must be scored strictly below 'documented'.

evidence.quote: Indeed, RNA-less alleles of hbegfa, vegfaa and alcama fail to upregulate hbegfb, vegfab and alcamb, respectively (Fig. 3a).
hbegfa RNA-less mutants displayed slow blood circulation, a phenotype not observed in hbegfaΔ7 mutants
vclaΔ13, vclasa14599, vclaexon22_ins1 ... mutants do not exhibit any obvious defects under a dissecting microscope.

zfin_corroboration.note: STRONG INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: ZFIN holds no substantive morphological phenotype for any vcla allele. The repo's own data agree that vcla nulls are silent.

evidence.quote: two other PTC bearing alleles, hbegfasa18135 and vclasa14599, do not display transcriptional adaptation
Using the hif1ab model, we observed that only transcripts containing sequences similar to epas1a led to an increase in epas1a mRNA levels

zfin_corroboration.note: CONFLICT with 'rescued': ZFIN carries 7 substantive terms across 6 publications (e.g. 'mitophagy muscle decreased occurrence'). El-Brolosy never claimed hif1ab mutants are phenotypically normal, only that they adapt, so this is a conflict with the OPTIMISTIC reading, not with the source.

cases.direction: BOTH -- adaptation documented AND requirement unmet

evidence.quote: Similarly, vegfaa mutants but not morphants show an upregulation of vegfab.
vegfaa promoter-less mutants displayed a stronger central artery (CtA) sprouting phenotype than vegfaaΔ10 mutants

112 substantive morphological terms across 22 ZFIN publications: 'dorsal longitudinal anastomotic vessel hypoplastic', 'blood circulation disrupted', 'angiogenic sprout central artery decreased amount'.

cases.why_it_matters: THE MOST IMPORTANT ROW IN THIS TABLE. vegfaa is a founding example of transcriptional adaptation AND has one of the best-replicated severe mutant phenotypes in zebrafish. Compensation was real and the functional requirement was still not met. Any scoring function that reads 'compensation documented' as 'requirement satisfied' gets vegfaa exactly wrong.

evidence.quote: egfl7 mutants do not show any obvious phenotypes while animals injected with egfl7 morpholino (morphants) exhibit severe vascular defects.
Among them are extracellular matrix genes that can rescue egfl7 morphants, indicating that they could be compensating for the loss of Egfl7 function in the phenotypically wild-type egfl7 mutants.

We also generated an egfl7 RNA-less allele and observed that, compared to the phenotypically wt egfl7Δ4 allele, the mutants displayed pronounced vascular defects (Fig. 3f) as well as milder upregulation of the emilin genes

zfin_corroboration.note: CONFLICT AT GENE LEVEL, resolved at allele level. 23 substantive terms exist, but they come from at least four publications including one (ZDB-PUB-190405-15, the El-Brolosy paper itself) that contributed the RNA-LESS allele's 'vasculature morphology' row, and a 2024 paper on brain lymphatic endothelial cells. Gene-level ZFIN counts cannot be used to contradict the allele-level claim.

cases.note_compensator: The adapting genes here are emilin family members, NOT paralogues of egfl7. A paralogue-only rule would miss this case entirely.

cases.note: Adaptation was MILDER, not abolished. R01 overstates the cleanliness of the RNA-less result and its counter-evidence field records this.

evidence.quote: alcama promoter-less mutants but not alcamaΔ8 mutants exhibited an elongated cardiac ventricle

zfin_corroboration.note: CONFLICT at gene level. 14 substantive terms, but 12 come from a 2009 publication (ZDB-PUB-090106-20) with no allele id attached -- very likely morpholino-era or a different allele. The El-Brolosy paper's own rows (ZDB-PUB-190405-15) are the bookkeeping terms plus 'cardiac ventricle elongated', which is the PROMOTER-LESS phenotype. Allele-level reading is consistent with the source.

evidence.quote: Unlike capn3a-knockdown embryos, which have small livers, and nid1a-knockdown embryos, which have short body lengths, capn3a-null and nid1a-null mutants appear normal.

zfin_corroboration.note: STRONG INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: zero substantive morphological terms for any capn3a allele in ZFIN. The repo's own data agree capn3a nulls are silent.

cases.confidence_cap: medium -- rests on ma2019, whose 2026 Author Correction content could not be retrieved

evidence.quote: capn3a-null and nid1a-null mutants appear normal.

zfin_corroboration.note: GENUINE CONFLICT, REPORTED NOT RESOLVED. ZFIN carries substantive nid1a allele phenotypes from THREE publications, including 'liver mislocalised' and 'liver absent' (ZDB-PUB-171126-1) and 'whole organism decreased length' (ZDB-PUB-171126-1 + ZDB-PUB-190405-14), plus 'retina morphology' and 'eye decreased size' from a third. Note that 'liver' and 'decreased length' are exactly the phenotypes Ma et al. attribute to the KNOCKDOWNS. Either different alleles behave differently, or the curated record disagrees with Ma et al.'s 'appear normal'. This conflict is left open.

cases.confidence_cap: low -- disputed by our own curated data

cases.allele: mef2ca mutant, selectively bred high- and low-penetrance strains

evidence.quote: selective breeding enriched for high and low mef2ca paralog expression in the low- and high-penetrance strains, respectively
mutagenizing the mef2ca paralogs, mef2aa, mef2b, mef2cb, and mef2d demonstrated modular buffering by paralogs. Specifically, some paralogs buffer severity while others buffer variability.

mef2cb is no longer required for craniofacial development, yet traces of the original craniofacial expression remain. The amount of vestigial expression is variable among individuals, resulting in variable buffering against mef2ca mutant phenotypes across a population.

cases.why_it_matters: The best zebrafish evidence that paralogue EXPRESSION LEVEL, not paralogue presence, is the causal variable -- and that buffering can be partial, variable between individuals of the same genotype, and distributed across four non-equivalent paralogues. It also shows a buffering paralogue can be phenotypically silent itself, so a paralogue's own phenotype is not a usable signal.

cases.allele: pcdh15a and pcdh15b single and double mutants

evidence.quote: The retinal phenotype is particularly illustrative of paralog cooperativity since pcdh15b single mutants have mild phenotypes even in aged animals, but severe retinal cell dysmorphology and cell death when both paralogs are mutated.
Genetic dosage experiments demonstrate that only Pcdh15a is necessary for dye uptake; pcdh15a+/-; pcdh15b-/- mutants shows no significant difference to WT controls

cases.why_it_matters: One paralogue pair, opposite verdicts in two tissues. This is the case that makes R06's tissue condition necessary rather than decorative, and it is the only case in the table that can TEST whether R06's tissue term does any work.

cases.allele: CRISPR single and double mutants at the Chr12 (derived) and Chr24 (ancestral) loci

evidence.quote: Zebrafish with both paralogs disrupted showed vestibular defects and early lethality from swim bladder inflation failure. One intact copy at either locus was sufficient to prevent major phenotypes.

Categorical phenotypes in double mutant animals showed 96% (54/56) penetrance after combining results from both Chr24 mutations. For Chr12 homozygotes with at least one wild-type allele at Chr24 penetrance was 7% (8/112)

cases.why_it_matters: Quantified buffering: 96% penetrance in doubles, 7% in derived-only singles, 0/110 in ancestral-only singles. Buffering is near-total and ASYMMETRIC by copy identity, which our paralogue input cannot express. Also note the authors state they did NOT measure whether one paralogue's expression rose, so this is buffering without a demonstrated adaptation response.

cases.note: Among the most severe and best-replicated zebrafish null phenotypes (30 publications). Nothing compensates it.

terms: convergent extension involved in neural plate elongation disrupted
olfactory epithelium lacks parts or has fewer parts of type

cases.note: fn1a has the paralogue fn1b, so this is a paralogue-present, not-buffered case.
tbxtb exists as a paralogue and does not rescue.

terms: pectoral fin endoskeletal disc decreased size

cases.note: shhb exists and does not rescue. Directly relevant to DELPHI: the pectoral fin terms are in the flying-fish trait path.
tbx5b exists and does not rescue the heart phenotype. Pectoral-fin relevant.
mitfb exists and does not rescue pigment-cell loss.
tyrp1a/tyrp1b exist and do not rescue.

terms: blood vessel heart vasculature increased amount

cases.why_it_matters: THE ASYMMETRY CASE within our own data. vcla and vclb are 85.7% identical paralogues. vcla nulls are phenotypically silent (C04, 0 substantive ZFIN terms); vclb nulls are not (33 substantive terms). Buffering ran one way only. A symmetric 'these two are paralogues, so either covers the other' rule is wrong on this pair, and our Ensembl rows cannot tell the two directions apart.

cases.note: The compensator in C07 is itself not buffered by vegfaa. Asymmetry again.

cases.adaptation: YES, at transcript AND protein level

evidence.quote: These findings are most readily explained by a lack of functional Ttn.2 protein in the heart and the lack of effective compensation by Ttn.1 or Cronos, despite evidence of some Ttn.1 upregulation.
peptides of Ttn.1 were upregulated throughout (2.55-fold upregulated and 295.6+/-37 Ttn.1 peptides in average compared with 287.8+/-16.8 peptides in WT)
qPCR for enriched-heart samples shows no significant upregulation of cronos
mutants in ttna (Fig. 4i-k) show a phenotype distinct from the published ttnb mutant runzel

cases.note: ttna has NO rows in our omics/genomic layer, so this case cannot be corroborated locally. A useful negative control datum from the same paper: ttn.1 (ttnb) e7 mutants have normal embryonic heart development, so Ttn.1 cannot substitute for Ttn.2 in heart.
cases.allele: six truncating alleles: e5, e25, e105, e129, e201, e232 (nonsense/frameshift, Z-disk to M-band)
cases.phenotype: homozygotes: marked cardiac dysfunction and early death; e129/e201 paralysed by 3 dpf
cases.why_it_matters: THE STRONGEST NOT-RESCUED CASE IN THE TABLE, and stronger than vegfaa, because the compensating paralogue was measured UP AT PROTEIN LEVEL (2.55-fold) and the phenotype was still not rescued. The authors also checked the alternative compensator (cronos) in the correct tissue and found nothing. Transcript up, protein up, requirement unmet.

evidence.quote: These include HBB, which did not induce its paralogs HBG1/2 or itself in HUDEP-2 cells

cases.note: SPECIES TRANSFER, and useful: HBG1/2 are developmentally silenced in adult-type erythroid cells, so R06's expression condition would correctly refuse this one for the right reason -- if we had human cell-line expression data, which we do not.

cases.allele_kind: nonsense (PTC-bearing NMD construct, split into 5 pieces)

evidence.quote: PKD1 (split into 5 pieces), which did not induce its paralog PKD2 in HEK cells

cases.note: PKD2 is expressed in HEK cells, so R06's expression condition would NOT save the rule here. A genuine would-be false positive.

cases.allele_kind: nonsense (PTC-bearing NMD construct, split into 4 pieces)

evidence.quote: Dmd (split into 4 pieces), which did not induce its paralog Utrn or itself in undifferentiated C2C12 cells

cases.note: DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS a published positive: a 2025 Nature paper from the same lineage reports 'Transcriptional adaptation upregulates utrophin in Duchenne muscular dystrophy' (PMID 39939773). Same gene pair, opposite results in different systems. Cell state, not genotype, decided the outcome. A genuine would-be false positive and the strongest single warning against extrapolating a documented case.

evidence.quote: ARG1, which did not induce its paralog ARG2 or itself in HepG2 cells

cases.phenotype: Marfan-syndrome-like cardiovascular phenotype -- the only fibrillin whose loss caused one

evidence.quote: arguing against transcriptional adaptation

cases.why_it_matters: Compensation TESTED and ABSENT: neither fbn1 nor fbn2 was upregulated. Also a clean illustration that TRANSCRIPTIONAL adaptation and FUNCTIONAL redundancy are separate predicates -- the same paper reports no adaptation yet infers functional redundancy among fibrillins from triple-knockout lethality.
cases.internal_tension: The paper rejects transcriptional adaptation in its Discussion but invokes functional compensation for the same negative result in its Limitations, supported by never recovering an adult triple knockout from ~300-400 adults genotyped. Recorded as a data-quality flag, not resolved.

cases.allele: RNA-less double knockout (promoter-flanking gRNAs, PTC-free by design)
cases.phenotype: thinner and stenosed outflow tract, reduced stroke volume, 75% dysmorphic aortic valves, elastic laminae absent in adults
cases.why_it_matters: A design-level confirmation of R01: the authors deliberately built RNA-LESS alleles specifically to preclude transcriptional adaptation, and got a severe phenotype. This is the field adopting R01 as experimental practice.

cases.phenotype: fails FM1-43 dye uptake; stereocilia bundle defect

evidence.quote: no evidence of transcriptional adaptation by pcdh15b

cases.why_it_matters: The negative half of C16, and it sharpens it: in the mechanosensory lineage there was no adaptation by pcdh15b AND no NMD of the mutant transcript. Same gene pair that DOES buffer in retina. Tissue decides.

cases.phenotype: complete absence of pectoral fins; tbx5a undetectable at 30 hpf
cases.why_it_matters: DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO DELPHI: the pectoral fin is the flying-fish trait path, and the cluster deletion abolishes it outright with no compensation. An RNA-less lesion by construction, so R01 refuses compensation and the published outcome agrees.

cases.phenotype: death by 28 dpf (12.0 +/- 4.7% survival); early muscle disease, axon guidance and retinal synapse defects

evidence.quote: genes that act on functional glycan assembly, including pomt1, pomt2, pomk, and b3galnt2 were not differentially expressed, nor was pomgnt1

cases.why_it_matters: Compensation TESTED across five candidate genes and ABSENT, and the mutant transcript was not even degraded -- so R02 correctly refuses adaptation here. Also the key MATERNAL-CONFOUND case (R13): the zygotic-only knockout survives to adulthood and looks compensated, the maternal-zygotic null dies.

honest_note: 12 of the 40 rows come from the same papers the rules were derived from, so testing the rules on those rows measures self-consistency, not predictive accuracy. Only the 8 rows marked held_out:true carry independent signal, and only 5 rows have compensation_tested:true (i.e. someone actually measured whether a compensator went up). The 11 ZFIN-only not-rescued rows (N01-N11) record a severe null phenotype but NOT a tested-and-absent compensation response, so they can only falsify an over-eager rule, never confirm a correct one. See VALIDATION in COMPENSATION.md.
